findings: The body does not read scenePhase. activeRequest is nil unless active; the task begins a new ticket before returning when inactive.
Current means Request equality, including subject and scene after placementRoom removal. Stale same-subject images remain eligible; stale errors and other-subject images are excluded.

Current image uses studyPreview and normal subject label, optional current backend and unsupported warning. Stale image uses studyPreviousPreview, no backend/warning, progress studyUpdating and AX text Previous render. [subject label]. Updating light study.
Current errors show studyUnavailable, message, and studyRetry. On active retry/re-entry the task clears matching failed frame before debounce; inactive exits before clearing.

Minimal correction: phase-gate only pending progress UI and stale-image Updating AX text; use a static paused cue while inactive, retain completed frame/error logic, visibility predicate, request normalization, work identity, ticket checks, debounce, engine and cache.
